q: Rina said, “Hurrah! We have completed the project successfully.” (Make it indirect.)
o: Rina exclaimed with joy that they had completed the project successfully.
Rina exclaimed with sorrow that they had completed the project successfully.
Rina exclaimed with joy that they have completed the project successfully.
Rina said that they had completed the project successfully.
e: Hurrah! আনন্দ প্রকাশ করে, তাই exclamatory sentence-এর indirect-এ reporting verb হয় exclaimed with joy। Hurrah ও বিস্ময়চিহ্ন বাদ যায়, আর quotation চিহ্নের স্থানে that আসে। Reported অংশে we বদলে they হয় এবং reporting verb past হওয়ায় have completed বদলে had completed হয়। সঠিক রূপ: Rina exclaimed with joy that they had completed the project successfully. With sorrow দুঃখ বোঝায়, আর have completed রেখে দিলে tense পাল্টায়নি।

q: The man said, “Good morning, my friends.”
o: The man said that my friends good morning
The man bade his friends good morning
The man wished his friends good morning
The man addressing his friends good morning
e: Good morning জাতীয় শুভেচ্ছা indirect-এ wished দিয়ে প্রকাশ হয়, আর সম্বোধিত ব্যক্তি object হয়: wished his friends good morning। My friends সম্বোধন, তাই my বদলে his হয়। সঠিক রূপ: The man wished his friends good morning। ‘Bade’-ও বিদায়ে বেশি ব্যবহৃত, সাধারণ শুভেচ্ছায় wished মানানসই। বাকি অপশনে ক্রিয়াই নেই বা গঠন ভুল।

q: I said to you, “He has done his duty.” Make it indirect speech.
o: I said to you that you have done your duty
I said to you that he had done his duty
I told you that you had done your duty
I told you that he has done your duty
e: Reported speech-এর present perfect (has done) indirect-এ past perfect (had done) হয়, কারণ reporting verb past। He এখানে তৃতীয় ব্যক্তি, তাই he-ই থাকে এবং his duty-ও অপরিবর্তিত থাকে। তাই “I said to you that he had done his duty”। অন্য অপশনে you/your বসে তৃতীয় ব্যক্তিকে শ্রোতা বানিয়ে ফেলা হয়েছে, আর ‘has done’ কাল বদলায়নি।

q: Which one is the correct indirect speech?
o: He asked me where was I going.
He asked me where am I going.
He asked me where I was going.
He asked me where I am going yesterday.
e:
Indirect speech-এ প্রশ্নবোধক বাক্য সাধারণ বাক্যের মতো সাজাতে হয়, অর্থাৎ subject আগে এবং verb পরে বসে (statement order)। তাই 'where was I' ভুল, সঠিক হলো 'where I was going'। Reporting verb 'asked' অতীত হওয়ায় বক্তব্যের verb-ও অতীত রূপে (was) আসে।
মনে রাখুন:
প্রশ্নবোধক চিহ্ন (?) indirect speech-এ বসে না।
উদাহরণ:
Direct: He said, "Where do you live?"
Indirect: He asked where I lived.
